summary: Frontend-only verification of the new two-step 'Delete rider' admin confirmation flow in RidersTab.jsx (ProfileModal). Signed in as El Prez (jb@glcc.club), opened non-president rider profiles via MemberCard -> Edit Profile, and validated the new confirm-delete-rider modal end-to-end. All four scenarios from the review request PASSED. Note: seed rider names sam/mika/leo/aroha were not present in this preview DB; used 'Test Rider One' (cancel target) and 'Test Rider Two' (confirm-delete target) and 'Rohan M' (admin-actions regression) instead.

test_results.test_1_cancel_flow: PASS - admin-delete opens confirm-delete-rider modal with correct copy ('Are you sure you want to delete this rider?' + '<Name> will be removed from the roster...'). confirm-delete-cancel closes only the confirmation; rider still present in roster (Test Rider One still visible: 2 occurrences).
test_results.test_2_confirm_flow: PASS - Yes, delete (confirm-delete-yes) removed 'Test Rider Two' from roster (0 occurrences after). Both the confirm modal and the ProfileModal closed (admin-delete count = 0 in DOM after action).
test_results.test_3_sanity_president_no_admin_delete: PASS - Jason Bryant's own profile shows no admin-delete button and no admin-actions section (self view). Self-service 'delete-account-block' is gated behind the 'Delete my account' toggle and is unaffected by this change.
test_results.test_4_other_admin_actions_regression: PASS - On Rohan M profile all other admin actions still render: admin-make (Make admin) = 1, admin-reset-password (Send reset link) = 1, admin-delete = 1. admin-remove not shown because target is not an admin (expected).

notes_on_review_request_testids: Review request referenced 'admin-make-admin', 'admin-remove-admin', 'admin-reset-link' but actual code uses 'admin-make', 'admin-remove', 'admin-reset-password'. Not a bug; just a testid naming mismatch in the review text. Adjusted assertions to real IDs.
critical_code_review_comments: RidersTab.jsx is 1111 lines - consider splitting ProfileModal, MemberCard, RegisterRiderModal into separate files (>700-line guideline).
Confirmation copy is clear and destructive-action colored (status-cant). Good UX.
confirm-delete overlay uses absolute inset-0 inside ProfileModal (z-40) - correctly stacks above profile content without covering global toasts.
test_credentials: jb@glcc.club / Roenick2707 (El Prez). Note: sam/mika/leo/aroha fixtures not present in preview DB.
seed_data_creation: Deleted 'Test Rider Two' during Test 2 (expected). 'Test Rider One' remains. If further testing is needed with those names, main agent can re-seed via /api/auth/register or invite flow.
